parts.one_line: A player-controlled vampire antagonist who drinks blood to survive, hides from deadly solar flares inside a claimed coffin, and builds a hierarchy by enslaving other crew as vassals.
player_facing_mechanics: Drink blood via the Feed power from living humans (or mice at a cost); feeding while aggressively grabbing puts the victim to sleep
Blood volume is a second resource pool separate from normal blood; you lose blood passively over time and go pale/weak/feral when low
Choose a Clan (Caitiff, Nosferatu, Ventrue, Malkavian, etc.) through a radial menu that grants a blood-drinking style, abilities and a clan objective
Rank/blood-level progression: earn unspent Ranks (from surviving sunlight cycles, latejoin bonuses, admin grant), spend them in a coffin to buy/upgrade powers
Claim a coffin as your Lair and protect it (lair objective); build a coffin from wood/metal
Sol (solar flare) cycle: you must sleep in a coffin during daylight or take burning/hindrance damage; HUD shows a countdown timer
Torpor: force-sleep in a coffin to heal; can be entered by death, by entering a coffin with heavy damage, or by Sol
Frenzy: when blood is critical you enter a feral stun/deaf/mute state that can only Feed and Trespass, and take burn damage per tick
Masquerade: appear and scan as a living human, hide your undead nature, suppress healing and vampiric traits

Buy and use a large power set: Feed, Cloak of Darkness, Fortitude, Masquerade, Vanishing Act (teleport to coffin as dawn nears), Brawn (break restraints/lockers/airlocks, punch, EMP cyborgs), Immortal Haste (dash), Predatory Lunge (grapple/rip out hearts), Mesmerize (freeze a mortal via eye contact), Trespass (mist-teleport through obstacles), Distress, Recuperate, Help Vassal
Make vassals by converting crew (population-scaled cap), assign them special roles (Favorite Vassal, Revenge Vassal, etc.), and have them stolen/broken when the Masquerade breaks
Break or maintain the Masquerade via Infractions; breaking it flags you for termination by other Bloodsuckers and lets your vassals be stolen
Objectives: claim a lair, survive until round end, vassalize command/a department, steal organic hearts, drink a target total of blood, plus a vassal objective to keep your master alive
Earn a generated vampire first name, title (Count/Countess, etc.) and reputation shown in examine and round-end report
Speak the vampiric language 'Blah-Sucker' (gained on conversion)
Custom HUD elements: blood counter, rank counter, sunlight timer
Antagonist info TGUI panel showing clan, powers and explanation; join-clan button
Mood events for feeding well, drinking dead/lesser/synthetic blood, killing a victim, sleeping in a coffin, or being near a cursed candelabrum
Appears both as a roundstart dynamic ruleset, a midround 'Vampiric Accident', and a latejoin 'Bloodsucker Breakout'

parts.port_notes: This is a large, deeply interwoven antagonist that maps well onto SS14 concepts: the /datum/antagonist/bloodsucker becomes a Gamerule/roundstart rule plus a Mind-role/component stack (Bloodsucker component holding blood volume, rank, clan, vassals), the powers become SS14 Actions on a shared ActionSystem, Sol becomes its own stalling system driven by a StationEvent/GameRule with a recurring timer, and vassalization becomes a role/relationship system using DoAfter for conversion and feeding. Signals (COMSIG_*) translate to the EventBus, traits to the Trait system/StatusEffects, and the custom HUD/screen counters to ClientUi/Info UI or alerts; mood events, objectives, dynamic ruleset caps and the TGUI AntagInfo panel map cleanly to mood prototypes, Objectives, roundstart rule weights and an antag-info UI. The main porting work is rewriting the procedural power behaviours (feed math, frenzy, torpor/heal, lunge/haste/mesmerize movement, coffin/Sol logic, organ and bodypart manipulation) as ECS systems, and the many direct /mob and /datum/reagent overwrites as component/system hooks. Open design questions for a human: how to model the clan/vassal hierarchy and 'special' vassal slots within SS14's antag framework, whether to keep the BYOND server-timed Sol subsystem or fold it into station events, how blood-volume-against-a-separate-resource should interact with SS14's Bloodstream/Chemistry, and how much of the sprawling power list to ship in a first pass.

parts.one_line: A vampire-style antagonist whose minions (vassals) can be tortured into loyal servants, who craft coffins, lairs and torture structures, disguise themselves, and get staked by crew.
player_facing_mechanics: Veil of Many Faces toggle power that randomizes your name/appearance and reverts it when toggled off
Claim a coffin as your lair inside a station area, which teaches you the lair crafting recipes
Coffin alt-click to lock/unlock from inside, or to unclaim/unwrench your coffin and all your structures
Enter torpor/rest in your coffin to heal and spend a rank when entering with unspent ranks
Coffins can be pried open with a crowbar (scaled by tool speed) and cannot be welded/deconstructed by non-owners
Vassal rack (persuasion rack) used to buckle victims and torture them into vassals over repeated clicks costing blood
Torture uses the inactive held item for speed/damage; targets with mindshields/other antags are offered a disloyalty accept/refuse prompt
Favorite vassals are made by continued torture once converted and become immune to mindshields depending on clan
Candelabrum structure that, while lit, drains sanity (hallucinations + mood event) of non-bloodsucker/non-vassal crew, togglable by vassals up close or bloodsuckers at range
Blood throne that lets a seated bloodsucker telepathically speak to all their vassals (and dead chat observes)
Structures must be bolted/secured by the owner in their lair to gain full function, unbolted via alt-click
Vassals get a Blood Bond pinpointer status effect that always tracks their master
Vassals are deconverted by mindshielding; ex-vassals must be fed bloodsucker blood to stay in the fold or lose the antag datum after 10 minutes
Revenge vassals survive their master's final death, inherit their powers, keep the other vassals and get a survive/avenge objective and new UI
Stakes carved from wood (upgradeable to hardened and silver) that can be driven into a stationary/unconscious target's chest to kill or disable a bloodsucker
Crafting recipes for coffins, persuasion rack, candelabrum, blood throne and stakes, some gated behind CRAFT_MUST_BE_LEARNED
Bloodbag of bloodsucker blood (B++ type) used by vassals; force-feeding and sipping bloodbags

parts.port_notes: Most content maps cleanly to SS14 as YAML prototypes: coffins/structures/items/stakes as entities, armor and stake stats as component fields, and crafting recipes as construction/lathe recipes with material requirements and research-gated variants. The real logic needs C# systems: a bloodsucker game rule plus vassal/ex-vassal/revenge antagonist datums become antag roles and mind components, torture becomes a DoAfter-driven vassal converter component, coffin claiming/lair becomes a system tracking claimed entities and a lair area, candelabrum mood drain and throne telepathy become systems driven by events (say/chat events, periodic ticks), and telepathy/veil map to actions and appearance/disguise components. A human must decide how torpor/frenzy/Sol, clan gating and power purchases (out of scope here, part 1) integrate, how to represent the mindshield deconversion and the blood-blood reagent refill, and whether the persuasion-rack torture loop should be a DoAfter or a UI-driven conversion.
